name: Abyssal Brace
lines: (5 items) Adds 1710 Maximum Health, While you are Bracing, you and group members within 12 meters of you gain Minor Evasion, reducing damage from area attacks by 10%.

name: Adamant Lurker
lines: (5 items) Gain 1505 Health Recovery while you are standing still.

name: Adept Rider
lines: (5 items) Gain Gallop and Major Expedition at all times, increasing your Movement Speed by 30% and Mounted Speed by 15%.

name: Aegis Caller
lines: (2 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you deal critical damage with a Martial melee attack, unleash a Lesser Aegis for 11 seconds. After 2.5 seconds, the Lesser Aegis spins its blades, dealing 479 Bleed Damage every 1 second. This effect can occur once every 12 seconds, scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage, and is considered pet damage.

name: Aegis of Galenwe
lines: (3 items) Gain Minor Aegis, reducing damage taken from monsters by 5%.

(5 items) When you Block, you grant Empower to 11 other group members within 15 meters for 3 seconds, increasing the damage of their Heavy Attacks against monsters by 150%. This effect can occur once every 2 seconds.
(3 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Dealing damage with a Light or Heavy Attack applies Eagle's Mark to your target for 12 seconds, causing an eagle to attack your target for 857 Physical Damage every 3 seconds, after a 3 seconds delay. Applying Eagle's Mark grants you Aerie's Call for 12 seconds, increasing your damage done by 10% against enemies with Eagle's Mark. This effect can occur every 3 seconds and you can have one Eagle's Mark active at a time.

name: Aetherial Ascension
lines: (5 items) Adds 7377 Armor. Increases the cost of Block, Sprint, Dodge, and Break Free by 20%.
(2 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Dealing damage with Burning Light twice within 30 seconds creates a 5 meter area 3.5 meters in front of you for 5 seconds. Dealing damage an Aedric Spear skill within the area launches a spear at your target, dealing 1684 Magic Damage and applying Sundered and increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by 300 for 10 seconds. The damage scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.
